scene: Through your brass telescope, three strange transit routes wait below.
picture: Close circular view through a brass-rimmed telescope lens divided into three viewports. On the left, a gleaming silver pneumatic mail train sits on an aerial rail. Centre shows a yellow tow truck with glowing winch cables parked on an overpass. On the right, a teal motorbike with an empty sidecar idles near an exit ramp.
shown: a tubular pneumatic mail train idling on the track, on the left
a bright yellow tow truck parked on an overpass, in the centre
a vintage motorbike with sidecar idling at a ramp, on the right
